parameters.content:
## On-demand scan
POST `{"host": "example.com"}` to this webhook. The SSL Labs node makes a single **Get Status** call: it returns a cached result up to 24 hours old, or starts an assessment and returns its progress (`DNS` / `IN_PROGRESS`).

Call again every 30-60 seconds until `ready` is true. This keeps the HTTP request short; assessments take minutes. Only scan hosts you own or are authorized to test.
